subtitle: Web Cinema iPhone Compatibility — Player Loading & Share Links
changes: Fixed iPhone and Safari-compatible Web Cinema iframe loading by requesting an external site’s real cross-origin sandbox identity, approved forms, storage-access-by-user-activation and immediate user-initiated loading instead of opaque-origin lazy frames
Added official embedded-player routing for supported share/video pages that use a video viewing key while keeping the original full saved URL and its access parameters intact

Added an optional Restricted viewing mode for users who prefer to limit external site identity and browser storage access, with Compatible mode available by default for better website/player functionality
Introduced a visible delayed recovery hint when an iPhone iframe remains blank, alongside user-initiated Reload, Open Externally, and a Try video source action for actual direct-media links

Maintained provider-controlled embedding permissions, browser cross-site cookie rules, access controls and encrypted-site restrictions; no proxy, authentication bypass, page scraping or forced iframe access was added
Retained saved video/website links, favorites, collections, direct-file progress and import/export files, without deleting or migrating existing browser storage
Preserved the original Video Vault player, live Sonic Theater, local music and Play on Start, iPhone Mobile Power Guard, all ORBIT studios, responsive UI and previously working media features
Preserved the existing GitHub Pages deployment, automated tests, previous rollback manifests and unchanged direct Discord release announcer
